official_control.description: Existing official STDN control. Do not rerun unless needed.

d1_bs16.description: Attribution D1: change batch size only (64 -> 16).

d2_bs16_pat30.description: Attribution D2: D1 + longer early-stopping patience (10 -> 30).

d3_regularized.description: Attribution D3: D2 + lower LR and explicit L2 regularization.

d4_low_lr.description: Sensitivity check: D3 with a smaller learning rate.
